def f(g):

 stat=[(max(Counter(r).values()),Counter(r).most_common(1)[0][0]) for r in g]
 best=max(x[0] for x in stat)
 gridbase=Counter([c for v,c in stat if v==best]).most_common(1)[0][0]
 rs=[i for i in range(h) if g[i].count(gridbase)>w/2]
 cs=[j for j in range(w) if sum(g[i][j]==gridbase for i in range(h))>h/2]
 M=[[g[i][j] for j in cs] for i in rs]
 # base fill from non-separator interior
 vals=[g[i][j] for i in range(h) if i not in rs for j in range(w) if j not in cs]
 fill=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
 marks=[]
 for r in range(len(M)-1):
  for c in range(len(M[0])-1):
   v=M[r][c]
   if v!=gridbase and M[r][c+1]==v and M[r+1][c]==v and M[r+1][c+1]==v:
    marks.append((r,c,v))
 if not marks:return [[fill]]
 r0=min(r for r,c,v in marks);r1=max(r for r,c,v in marks)
 c0=min(c for r,c,v in marks);c1=max(c for r,c,v in marks)
 out=[[fill]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
 for r,c,v in marks:out[r-r0][c-c0]=v
 return out

code='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The gridline color is the modal color on the most uniform rows.
    row_modes = [(max(Counter(row).values()), Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0])
                 for row in grid]
    best_count = max(count for count, _ in row_modes)
    line_color = Counter(color for count, color in row_modes
                         if count == best_count).most_common(1)[0][0]

    horizontal = [r for r in range(height)
                  if grid[r].count(line_color) > width / 2]
    vertical = [c for c in range(width)
                if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(height)) > height / 2]
    intersections = [[grid[r][c] for c in vertical] for r in horizontal]

    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(height) if r not in horizontal
                for c in range(width) if c not in vertical]
    fill_color = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]

    marks = []
    for r in range(len(intersections) - 1):
        for c in range(len(intersections[0]) - 1):
            color = intersections[r][c]
            if (color != line_color
                    and intersections[r][c + 1] == color
                    and intersections[r + 1][c] == color
                    and intersections[r + 1][c + 1] == color):
                marks.append((r, c, color))

    top = min(r for r, _, _ in marks)
    bottom = max(r for r, _, _ in marks)
    left = min(c for _, c, _ in marks)
    right = max(c for _, c, _ in marks)
    output = [[fill_color] * (right - left + 1)
              for _ in range(bottom - top + 1)]
    for r, c, color in marks:
        output[r - top][c - left] = color
    return output
'''
